brief_rationale: Doctor completed all responsibility chain items with comprehensive red flag screening, proper condition anchoring, active workspace verification, safe delay counseling, executable handoff plan, real-world barrier strategies, and explicit patient confirmation. Three high-order points achieved: HO1 with specific cost/work reduction strategies, HO2 by clarifying one-month follow-up doesn't cancel specialist treatment, and HO3 with empathetic adaptation to work/leave pressures. Safe, traceable closure with patient teach-back. Two complete high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact earns grade 5.
